source: derived — mirrored S/Z threading must produce a mirrored band. CORRECTED: the inner cards originally read [2,2,1,1] (the plan's own example), which is impossible to mirror and has been changed to [2,1,2,1]. Proof: an S card and a Z card both threaded [2,2,1,1], turned forward together from start 0, show colours 2,1,1,2 (S, picks 1-4) against 1,1,2,2 (Z, picks 1-4) — never equal at picks 1 or 3, so the band can never be a palindrome, regardless of src/conventions.ts. [2,1,2,1] is self-mirroring (colors[1] == colors[3] == 1) and also matches this fixture's own prose, 'alternating cream/madder', which [2,2,1,1] (blocked, not alternating) did not. See task-4-report.md for the full derivation.
